rationales.signal: Authentication, authorization, sessions, and administrative operations
rationales.evidence: The application implements login and sessions while mounting reporting, upload, document-management, and generation routes.

rationales.signal: LLM, RAG, embeddings, and externally supplied corpus content
rationales.evidence: Uploaded documents can be embedded, activated, retrieved, and inserted into LLM context.

rationales.signal: CI/CD production authority and artifact supply chain
rationales.evidence: Deployment jobs obtain cloud credentials, promote mutable image tags, and execute remotely retrieved scripts.
A server-side API route uses a provider key to mint and return external session tokens.

required_treatment: ADDER secure-code, secrets, LLM, dependency, package-trust, test-evidence, and threat-model review
Independent security testing in an authorized isolated environment
No autonomous merge or production deployment
affected_trust_boundaries: Internet or client to backend API
Uploaded content to vector store and LLM context
Application to model and avatar providers
CI runner to remote download source and cloud deployment accounts
Application and model data to operational logs
unknowns: Upstream gateway authentication and network restrictions
Current deployed revision and runtime configuration
